Cato's @cpgrabow and @JaiKedia discussed the new Cato Institute Handbook on Affordability at a Capitol Hill briefing, making the case that lasting affordability comes from greater economic freedom, not more government intervention.

Check it out: ow.ly/Ypq050ZenBR

Online sales bans of e-cigarettes failed to reduce youth vaping. Cato’s @jeffreyamiron writes that young people rarely bought online to begin with, shifting to in-person and social sources instead. Policy that restricts choice without achieving its goal always ends up unsuccessful.
